title: archive.ingest input
description: Names exactly one operator-declared archive knowledge source (its `brain.sources` id). Every selection rule, the export path, and the dedupe strategy are the declaration's fields — this input names the source only, so the approval binds the declaration, not caller-supplied arguments. The source id is registry configuration data and is deliberately not enumerated here.

source.description: The declared `brain.sources` key of one archive knowledge source.
